CustomField.description: How many days before an Opportunity's Re-approach Eligibility Date the reminder Task should be created. 0 = create it on the eligibility date itself; 30 = create it 30 days ahead. Read at runtime by the Create Re-approach Task scheduled flow, so changing this record changes the lead time with no flow edit.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Days before the Re-approach Eligibility Date to create the reminder Task. 0 = on the date itself.
CustomField.label: Days Before Eligibility
